visual_inspection.method: Inspected matched native market/wizard/bridge screenshots for all five primary styles and chronological actual NPC crops at video ticks0/24/96/198/237 (frog) and0/64/128/192/256 (wizard). No automated art-quality score. All pixels come from the real full-frame archives, enlarged only by nearest neighbour for the diagnostic.
visual_inspection.finding: No visible actor/staff/rail occlusion or grip disconnection blocker in these sampled views. The breathing pose lowers the torso/head together; the wizard hood remains legible and its flame stays at the staff tip. Style4 deliberately has the darkest/filthiest field; style2 retains a busier cobble rhythm than3.
